model_type: Logistic Regression (cross-check/fallback role, NOT primary decision-maker)
ml_model_role: Cross-check: if ML prediction disagrees with the lookup table's answer, flag for human review. Fallback: used only when Category is missing or unrecognized.
known_limitation: Step 13 found the ML model's Category coefficient (~0.49) is weaker than its learned text-token signal (~0.77 summed) for at least one class, because both were equally deterministic in training. Adversarial testing showed correct-but-thin margins as low as 3.1 percentage points with competing department-associated words. This is exactly why the ML model is NOT the primary decision path.
